description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueDao interface, which specifies data access methods for ProductOptionValue entities in the context of a shop management system, including methods to retrieve options based on store, language, id, name, and code.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to ProductOptionValue entities, extending generic DAO functionality with store-specific methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValues associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductOptionValues matching the given name within a store and language context.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Returns a list of ProductOptionValues for a store and language, possibly without read-only restrictions.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Gets a ProductOptionValue by store and its unique code.
